fullIdentity: SELECT current_user AS role,current_database() AS database,current_setting('server_version') AS version,current_setting('server_version_num')::int AS version_num,current_setting('data_directory') AS data_directory,current_setting('port')::int AS port,inet_server_port() AS server_port,host(inet_server_addr()) AS address,pg_backend_pid() AS backend_pid,system_identifier::text AS system_identifier,floor(extract(epoch FROM pg_postmaster_start_time()))::bigint::text AS started_epoch FROM pg_control_system()
runtimeIdentity: SELECT current_user AS role,current_database() AS database,current_setting('server_version_num')::int AS version_num,inet_server_port() AS server_port,host(inet_server_addr()) AS address,pg_backend_pid() AS backend_pid,r.rolsuper,r.rolbypassrls,r.rolcreatedb,r.rolcreaterole,r.rolinherit,r.rolreplication,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_auth_members WHERE member=r.oid) AS memberships FROM pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname=current_user
settings: SELECT current_schema() AS schema,current_setting('DateStyle') AS date_style,current_setting('TimeZone') AS time_zone,current_setting('search_path') AS search_path
sampleStamp: WITH moment AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT clock_timestamp() AS n) SELECT to_char(n AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS at_exact,to_char((n-interval '1 microsecond') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS member_exact,to_char((n+interval '1 second') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS future_exact FROM moment
namespaceAbsence: SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname=$1
authTables: CREATE TABLE "user"(id text PRIMARY KEY,email text NOT NULL,"emailVerified" boolean NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE "session"(id text PRIMARY KEY,"userId" text NOT NULL REFERENCES "user"(id),"expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL)
authAcl: SELECT has_table_privilege(current_user,'"user"','SELECT') AS user_select,has_table_privilege(current_user,'"user"','INSERT') AS user_insert,has_table_privilege(current_user,'"user"','UPDATE') AS user_update,has_table_privilege(current_user,'"user"','DELETE') AS user_delete,has_table_privilege(current_user,'"session"','SELECT') AS session_select,has_table_privilege(current_user,'"session"','INSERT') AS session_insert,has_table_privilege(current_user,'"session"','UPDATE') AS session_update,has_table_privilege(current_user,'"session"','DELETE') AS session_delete,has_column_privilege(current_user,'"session"','id','UPDATE') AS session_id_update,has_column_privilege(current_user,'"session"','userId','UPDATE') AS session_user_update,has_column_privilege(current_user,'"session"','expiresAt','UPDATE') AS session_expiry_update
timeouts: SELECT name,setting,unit FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('statement_timeout','lock_timeout','idle_in_transaction_session_timeout','transaction_timeout') ORDER BY name
authCatalog: SELECT c.relname AS name,c.relacl::text AS acl,(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',a.attname,'type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'notNull',a.attnotnull,'number',a.attnum) ORDER BY a.attnum) FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid=c.oid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped) AS columns,(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind',k.contype,'keys',k.conkey,'parentKeys',k.confkey,'parent',k.confrelid::regclass::text,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid)) ORDER BY k.conname COLLATE "C") FROM pg_constraint k WHERE k.conrelid=c.oid) AS constraints FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relnamespace=current_schema()::regnamespace AND c.relname IN ('user','session') AND c.relkind='r' ORDER BY c.relname

reportComposite: SELECT id,to_jsonb(t) AS row,octet_length(to_jsonb(t)::text)::int AS bytes FROM os_reports t WHERE org_id=$1 AND payload->>'format' LIKE 'charitology-participation-occurrence-generation%' ORDER BY id
lastRestoreAudit: SELECT detail FROM os_events WHERE org_id=$1 AND action='backup.restored' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
exactRecords: SELECT to_jsonb(t) AS row,to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS created_exact,to_char(updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS updated_exact,to_char(deleted_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS deleted_exact FROM os_records t WHERE org_id=$1 ORDER BY id COLLATE "C"
expireAccepted: UPDATE os_previews SET expires_at=clock_timestamp()-interval '1 second' WHERE org_id=$1 AND id=$2 AND actor_id=$3 AND kind='participation-recurrence-v1' AND committed_at IS NOT NULL AND payload->>'format'='charitology-participation-recurrence-receipt'
expiryWitness: WITH moment AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT clock_timestamp() AS n) SELECT to_char(n AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS now_exact,to_char(p.expires_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS expires_exact,p.expires_at<n AS expired,floor(extract(epoch FROM (p.expires_at-n))*1000)::bigint::text AS remaining_ms FROM os_previews p CROSS JOIN moment WHERE p.org_id=$1 AND p.id=$2 AND p.kind='participation-recurrence-v1' AND p.committed_at IS NOT NULL
grantFaultSequence: GRANT USAGE,SELECT ON SEQUENCE os_rr_fault_seq TO __RUNTIME__
faultSequenceValue: SELECT CASE WHEN is_called THEN last_value ELSE 0 END::int AS calls FROM os_rr_fault_seq
createBallastSequences: CREATE SEQUENCE os_rr_ballast_fired; CREATE SEQUENCE os_rr_ballast_bytes
grantBallastSequences: GRANT USAGE,SELECT,UPDATE ON SEQUENCE os_rr_ballast_fired,os_rr_ballast_bytes TO __RUNTIME__
ballastWitness: SELECT (SELECT CASE WHEN is_called THEN last_value ELSE 0 END FROM os_rr_ballast_fired)::text AS fired,(SELECT CASE WHEN is_called THEN last_value ELSE 0 END FROM os_rr_ballast_bytes)::text AS bytes,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM os_reports WHERE org_id='rr_quota' AND id='rr-quota-ballast') AS rows
contextFree: SELECT (SELECT count(*)::int FROM os_records) AS records,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM os_reports) AS reports,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM os_previews) AS previews
catalogVector: SELECT t.relname AS table_name,array_agg(a.attname::text ORDER BY a.attnum) AS columns FROM pg_class t JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.relnamespace JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=t.oid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped WHERE n.nspname=current_schema() AND t.relkind IN ('r','p') AND t.relname LIKE 'os\_%' ESCAPE '\' GROUP BY t.relname ORDER BY t.relname COLLATE "C"
reportCatalog: SELECT jsonb_build_object('schema',current_schema(),'name',c.relname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),'rls',c.relrowsecurity,'forced',c.relforcerowsecurity,'columns',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',a.attname,'type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'notNull',a.attnotnull) ORDER BY a.attnum) FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid=c.oid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped),'userTriggers',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',t.tgname,'enabled',t.tgenabled,'definition',pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,true)) ORDER BY t.tgname) FROM pg_trigger t WHERE t.tgrelid=c.oid AND NOT t.tgisinternal)) AS catalog FROM pg_class c WHERE c.oid='os_reports'::regclass
reportAcl: SELECT has_table_privilege(current_user,'os_reports','SELECT') AS can_select,has_table_privilege(current_user,'os_reports','INSERT') AS can_insert,has_table_privilege(current_user,'os_reports','UPDATE') AS can_update,has_table_privilege(current_user,'os_reports','DELETE') AS can_delete,has_table_privilege(current_user,'os_reports','TRUNCATE') AS can_truncate
seedRange: WITH moment AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT clock_timestamp()+($1::integer*interval '1 day') AS n) SELECT to_char(n AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') AS start_at,to_char((n+interval '1 hour') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') AS end_at FROM moment
recurrenceReports: SELECT org_id,id,created_by,title,checksum,payload,to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS created_at FROM os_reports WHERE org_id=$1 AND payload->>'format' LIKE 'charitology-participation-occurrence-generation%' ORDER BY id COLLATE "C"
recurrenceCounts: SELECT (SELECT count(*)::int FROM os_reports WHERE org_id=$1 AND payload->>'format' LIKE 'charitology-participation-occurrence-generation%') AS reports,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM os_events WHERE org_id=$1 AND action='participation-recurrence.generated') AS audits,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM os_previews WHERE org_id=$1 AND kind='participation-recurrence-v1' AND committed_at IS NOT NULL) AS receipts
exactPreviews: SELECT org_id,id,actor_id,kind,payload,checksum,base_revision,to_char(expires_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS expires_at,to_char(committed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS committed_at,to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS created_at FROM os_previews WHERE org_id=$1 AND id=$2
sideEffects: SELECT (SELECT count(*)::int FROM os_participant_links WHERE org_id=$1) AS links,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM os_participations WHERE org_id=$1) AS participations,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM os_participation_outbox WHERE org_id=$1) AS outbox,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM os_jobs WHERE org_id=$1) AS jobs,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM os_publications WHERE org_id=$1) AS publications,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM os_integrations WHERE org_id=$1 AND encrypted_token IS NOT NULL) AS credentials
noRecurrenceAuthority: SELECT (SELECT count(*)::int FROM os_previews WHERE org_id=$1 AND kind='participation-recurrence-v1') AS previews,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM os_participant_links WHERE org_id=$1) AS links,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM os_participation_outbox WHERE org_id=$1) AS outbox,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM os_integrations WHERE org_id=$1 AND encrypted_token IS NOT NULL) AS credentials
createdAudits: SELECT record_id,detail->'record' AS record FROM os_events WHERE org_id=$1 AND action='record.created' AND record_id=ANY($2::text[]) ORDER BY record_id COLLATE "C"
duplicateReceipt: INSERT INTO os_previews(org_id,id,actor_id,kind,payload,checksum,base_revision,expires_at,committed_at,created_at) SELECT org_id,$3,actor_id,kind,payload,checksum,base_revision,expires_at,committed_at,created_at FROM os_previews WHERE org_id=$1 AND id=$2 AND kind='participation-recurrence-v1' AND committed_at IS NOT NULL
runtimeActivity: SELECT pid,state,xact_start IS NULL AS no_transaction FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname=current_database() AND usename=current_user AND pid=ANY($1::int[]) AND pid<>$2 ORDER BY pid
faultObjects: SELECT kind,name FROM (SELECT 'trigger'::text AS kind,t.tgname::text AS name FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname=current_schema() AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND t.tgname IN ('rr_failure','rr_ballast') UNION ALL SELECT 'function',p.proname::text FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.pronamespace=current_schema()::regnamespace AND p.proname IN ('os_rr_fault_guard','os_rr_ballast_guard') UNION ALL SELECT 'sequence',c.relname::text FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relnamespace=current_schema()::regnamespace AND c.relkind='S' AND c.relname IN ('os_rr_fault_seq','os_rr_ballast_fired','os_rr_ballast_bytes')) owned ORDER BY kind,name
